capabilities: Manage translation status of all plugins in a unified panel
Switch language independently per plugin and restart plugins to apply it
Edit existing translations via overlay mode without modifying the plugin
Import, export, and download community translation packages
Provide zero-dependency i18n adapters and codemods for plugin developers
disambiguation: Translates the interfaces of third-party plugins, not Obsidian itself or the content of notes.
extras: The README warns the project was built using Vibe Coding (AI-assisted coding) and asks users to avoid it if uncomfortable with that approach; deeper documentation (whitepaper, migration guide) lives outside the README.
problem: Obsidian plugins each handle their own translations, so users have no unified way to view, correct, or switch plugin languages.
summary: Translation manager for third-party plugins with per-plugin locale switching, overlay editing, shared dictionaries, and i18n adapters for developers.
